summary: The TG7 'finite-cover/power flat lines nontrivial' target is real, but main already proves it (Irrational.lean, and FlatTorus.lean's ∂bar coercivity on every power and finite cover), so this PR adds a second parallel route while the description falsely says main has nothing here. State why the holomorphic Liouville form is needed for the next TG7 step (the zero-section theorem) and relate it to the existing results.
